cases.translation: No one takes this to heart.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) takes dative case.

cases.sentence: Те, кто ходят в ___, вступают в покой.
cases.translation: Those who walk in truth enter into peace.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) takes prepositional case with the meaning 'in'.
Direct object of the verb 'находят' takes accusative case.

cases.translation: You set your bed on a mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition на with accusative means 'onto' or 'to'.

cases.translation: He does not hear the voice of my people.
cases.explain: The verb 'слышать' (to hear) can govern the genitive in this context.

cases.translation: Are you not a child of apostasy?
cases.explain: Predicate nominative after the verb 'быть' (to be).

cases.translation: Their life was full of sin.
cases.explain: The adjective 'полна' (full) takes genitive case to express what fills something.

cases.sentence: Но сделавший меня своим прибежищем унаследует ___.
cases.translation: But he who takes me as refuge will inherit the land.
cases.explain: Direct object of the verb 'унаследует' (will inherit) takes accusative case.

reading.ru: Праведные гибнут, и никто не принимает этого к сердцу.
reading.question: What is happening to the righteous?
reading.explain: The text states 'Праведные гибнут' (the righteous perish).

reading.ru: Те, кто ходят в правде, вступают в покой, в смерти они находят успокоение.
reading.question: What do those who walk in truth find?
reading.explain: The text says they 'вступают в покой' (enter into peace) and find 'успокоение' (rest).

reading.ru: Разве вы не дети отступничества, не порождения лжи?
reading.question: Who are being addressed as children of apostasy?
options: Those who have turned away from God
reading.correct: Those who have turned away from God
reading.explain: The text calls them 'дети отступничества' (children of apostasy).

reading.ru: Я разоблачу твою праведность и твои дела, и они тебе не помогут.
reading.question: What will God reveal?
reading.explain: God says He will 'разоблачу' (expose/reveal) their 'праведность и твои дела' (righteousness and deeds).

reading.ru: Но сделавший меня своим прибежищем, унаследует землю и будет владеть моей святой горой.
reading.question: What will those who take refuge in God receive?
options: The land and God's holy mountain
reading.correct: The land and God's holy mountain
reading.explain: The text promises that those who make God their refuge will 'унаследует землю' (inherit the land) and possess 'моей святой горой' (my holy mountain).

reading.ru: Господь будет твоим вечным светом, и кончатся дни твоей скорби.
reading.question: What does the text promise about God's role?
options: God will be your eternal light
reading.correct: God will be your eternal light
reading.explain: The text states 'Господь будет твоим вечным светом' (The Lord will be your eternal light).
